TSMC is reportedly weighing a 10–20% hike for CoWoS packaging — the glue binding AI chips to HBM. Demand is no longer just GPUs: server CPUs and custom ASICs want in too, and equipment lead times are now 6–8 months. Packaging is the new bottleneck. (reportedly, Commercial Times)

CoWoS-R puts a logic chip and HBM side by side on an RDL interposer made of polymer and copper traces. Tech Daily | No. 10 of 16

TSMC's website lists a minimum RDL line width/spacing of 2/2 µm. A 2025 ECTC TSMC paper reports 1.4/1.4 µm, finer than that 2/2 µm. More in reply. https://t.co/AYoLbhsG9G
